data.notes: January 2026 in Cartagena was anchored by the 20th Cartagena Festival de Música, with additional high-end electronic parties and Hay Festival music programming later in the month.

events.title: Cartagena XX Festival de Música 2026
events.summary: The 20th Cartagena Festival de Música ran under the theme “El Alma y el Cuerpo,” with concerts across Teatro Adolfo Mejía, Centro de Convenciones, Sofitel Santa Clara, Palacio de la Proclamación and other city venues.

events.title: Cartagena Festival de Música: Concierto inaugural
events.summary: The festival opened with the Orquesta de Cámara Franz Liszt conducted by István Várdai, with violinist Simon Zhu performing a program including Mozart, Tchaikovsky and Paganini.

events.title: RUMORS Cartagena: Guy Gerber & Jan Blomqvist
events.summary: Resident Advisor listed RUMORS Cartagena with Guy Gerber, Jan Blomqvist, Monobase and Kuda, running 20:00–03:00 at a Museo Naval Cartagena location.

events.title: Grandbrothers Elsewhere Tour 2026
events.venueName: Capilla del Hotel Sofitel Santa Clara
events.summary: Grandbrothers brought their Elsewhere live show to the Cartagena Festival de Música, pairing acoustic piano with electronic textures, synthesizers and drum-machine-driven rhythms.

events.title: Lost Miracle Cartagena: Sébastien Léger & Roy Rosenfeld
events.summary: Lost Miracle’s Cartagena date featured Sébastien Léger and Roy Rosenfeld at Atolón on Isla Tierra Bomba, with the ticket page listing a 14:00–02:00 schedule.

events.title: Cody Fry: Música para un nuevo mundo
events.summary: Cody Fry performed with the Filarmónica Joven de Colombia as part of Cartagena Festival de Música, presenting a symphonic-pop program at Auditorio Getsemaní.

events.title: Paquito sinfónico: entre lo clásico y el jazz
events.summary: Paquito d’Rivera Quinteto closed the Cartagena Festival de Música calendar with a free Plaza de la Aduana concert joining jazz improvisation, orchestral writing and Latin repertoire.

events.title: Hay Festival Cartagena: Concierto de La Pambelé
events.summary: Hay Festival Cartagena programmed La Pambelé for a 21:00 salsa-brava concert at the Centro de Convenciones Explanada, presenting material from Nací mestizo.

events.title: Giolì & Assia - Cartagena
events.summary: Resident Advisor listed Italian electronic duo Giolì & Assia in Cartagena for a 19:00–04:00 melodic-house event promoted by Booth and Los Calvitos Events.
